name_note: Part of the genomes GTDB places in this genus carry the NCBI label Succinatimonas, a different genus, so only sources that use the name Succinivibrio are cited here.

sentences.text: A strain isolated from cow faeces and assigned to the genus Succinivibrio was described as Gram-stain-negative, obligately anaerobic, non-motile, non-spore-forming and helical rod-shaped.
A study of the Juǀ'hoansi, a hunter-gatherer community in northeastern Namibia, reported that their bacterial intestinal microbiome was enriched for genera including Succinivibrio.
A study of Indigenous communities in Sarawak reported Succinivibrio among VANISH microbes that were dominant genera in their gut microbiota, contrasting with a Kuala Lumpur urban cohort.

Among 143 healthy rural and urban Tanzanians in a yellow fever vaccine trial, rural-associated microbiota showed higher diversity and enrichment of taxa like Succinivibrio, which were linked to dietary intake patterns.
